title: Company Secretary
description:
**Role Overview:**

We are looking for a Company Secretary to own regulatory compliance and corporate governance at Liquify. The role will help ensure that we meet the standards our RBI-regulated lending partners expect from a Lending Service Provider (LSP), maintain accurate corporate and ROC compliance, and work closely with product, technology and operations teams to embed compliance into new initiatives.

**RBI and Digital Lending Compliance**

Own Liquify’s compliance as a Lending Service Provider under the RBI Digital Lending Directions, 2025.

Manage lending-partner due diligence, LSP agreements and periodic reviews.

Keep borrower disclosures, Key Fact Statements (KFS) and grievance-redressal processes compliant and current.

Track RBI circulars and translate regulatory changes into clear actions for product, technology and operations teams.

**Corporate Secretarial and ROC Compliance**

* Coordinate Board meetings, AGMs and EGMs in accordance with the Companies Act, 2013 and Secretarial Standards SS-1 / SS-2.
* Draft notices, agendas, minutes and resolutions; maintain statutory registers and records.
* Prepare, file and track ROC/MCA forms, including AOC-4, MGT-7, ADT-1, DIR-3 KYC, DPT-3, MSME-1 and MGT-14, as applicable.
* Manage corporate actions and filings relating to changes in directors, share capital and registered office.

**Policies, Data Protection and Governance**

* Draft and refresh Board-approved policies covering fair practices, grievance redressal, privacy, outsourcing and code of conduct.
* Lead readiness activities for the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, in coordination with technology and security teams.
* Manage the policy review cycle and maintain audit-ready, version-controlled evidence.

**Contracts, Audits and Reporting**

* Review compliance clauses in lender, channel-partner and vendor agreements in coordination with legal counsel.
* Prepare declarations, undertakings and compliance certificates required by partners.
* Coordinate statutory, internal and partner audits, and draft responses to regulatory notices.
* Maintain the master compliance calendar and prepare regular compliance reports for management and the Board.

**Candidate Requirements**

**Must Have**

* Qualified Company Secretary (ACS / FCS), member of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI).
* 2-5 years of post-qualification experience in secretarial and regulatory compliance, ideally in lending, fintech or financial services.
* Working knowledge of the RBI Digital Lending Directions, 2025, including the lender–LSP framework, KFS and grievance redressal.
* Strong command of the Companies Act, 2013, SS-1 / SS-2 and the MCA portal.
* Strong drafting skills for Board papers, policies, and regulator or partner responses.
* Excellent deadline management and sound judgement where regulatory requirements are evolving.

**Good to Have**

* Knowledge of SEBI compliance requirements.
* Experience at an NBFC, bank or SEBI-registered intermediary.
* Familiarity with the DPDP Act, 2023, KYC / AML norms and IT outsourcing guidelines.
* Experience handling partner audits or regulatory inspections.
* Comfort with compliance software and building practical trackers.
* Ability to explain regulatory requirements in plain language to product, technology and business teams.

**Why Join Liquify?**

* Ownership: Lead the compliance function and help shape how the business operates.
* Breadth: Work across RBI requirements, the Companies Act and data protection in a multi-partner environment.
* Build: Collaborate with product and technology teams while new credit products are being designed.

Minimum 2 years in handling secretarial and governance responsibilities for unlisted entities.

* Ensure compliance with applicable DoT guidelines, TRAI regulations, telecom licence conditions, TERM Cell requirements, and other relevant regulatory directives.
* Monitor regulatory notifications, circulars, amendments, and policy changes; assess their impact and coordinate timely implementation.
* Coordinate with DoT, TRAI, TERM Cell, and other relevant authorities on regulatory submissions, inspections, audits, and compliance queries.
* Act as a key liaison with authorised Law Enforcement Agencies (LEAs), including police departments, cybercrime units, and intelligence agencies.
* Oversee the receipt, validation, tracking, documentation, and timely processing of lawful interception and data disclosure requests in accordance with applicable law and approved procedures.

* Support internal and external audits, regulatory inspections, and compliance reviews; ensure records are complete, accurate, and readily accessible.
* Identify regulatory risks, compliance gaps, and process weaknesses; recommend corrective and preventive actions and track closure.
* Build and maintain professional working relationships with government officials, regulatory authorities, law enforcement stakeholders, and internal leadership.
* Manage sensitive escalations and confidential communications with appropriate discretion, information security, and adherence to approved access controls.
* Provide management updates on regulatory developments, pending matters, compliance status, risks, and improvement initiatives.

**Qualification & Experience**

* Education: Graduate or postgraduate qualification in Law, Public Administration, Management, or a related discipline preferred.
* Experience: 7+ years of overall professional experience, preferably with substantial experience in telecom regulatory compliance, nodal affairs, government relations, or legal operations.
* Industry Exposure: Experience with a telecom operator or telecommunications service provider is strongly preferred.
* Certifications (if any): Relevant certifications or professional development in telecom regulations, legal compliance, public administration, or regulatory affairs will be an added advantage.

* DoT / TRAI / TERM Cell compliance and understanding of applicable telecom regulatory requirements.
* Nodal and regulatory operations; LEA coordination and authorised request management.
* Regulatory framework development, SOPs, compliance calendars, trackers, and audit documentation.
* Legal documentation, regulatory correspondence, court coordination, and evidence-related documentation.
* Regulatory audits, MIS reporting, risk identification, confidentiality, and escalation management.
* Knowledge of telecom licence conditions, security requirements, and lawful interception/data disclosure procedures.
* Added advantages: Experience with regulatory portals, compliance systems, and dashboard-based reporting.

**Functional Skills:**

* Interpretation of regulatory requirements and translation into operational processes.
* Regulatory submissions, deadline management, and compliance monitoring.
* Government liaison, LEA coordination, and stakeholder management.
* Legal record management, audit readiness, and corrective action tracking.
* Cross-functional coordination with Legal, Network, IT, Information Security, and business teams.

**Behavioral Competencies:**

* High integrity, discretion, and sound judgment when handling confidential matters.
* Strong ownership, accountability, and attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage time-sensitive requests, escalations, and competing priorities.
* Strong analytical, risk assessment, and problem-solving abilities.
* Stakeholder influence, collaboration, and continuous improvement mindset.

* Oversee and ensure prompt delivery of invoices and debit notes to customers

* Monitor exposure limits, debtor aging, credit utilization, and overdue accounts.
* Ensure timely collection of cargo value, premiums, penalties, interest charges, and logistics-related recoveries.
* Strengthening commercial controls to prevent revenue leakage and financial exposure.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with customers and strategic stakeholders.
* Drive service excellence and enhance customer satisfaction.
* Lead and manage cross-functional commercial teams.

* Facilitate the timely signing of contracts, collection of payments, and sharing of relevant documents for shipment
* Oversee vessel discharge and customs clearance for smooth operations
* Collaborate with third parties for contract signing, payment collection, laytime settlement, and contract closures

* Ensure strict adherence to standard contract terms, deviation controls,
* Ensure statutory compliances and other regulatory requirements.
* Ensure adherence to corporate policies, regulatory requirements, and internal control frameworks.

* Manage third-party transportation coordination and customer account reconciliation
* Ensure accounting-related tasks, such as ledger clearing, provisions, LC clearing, book hygiene, cargo ageing management, inventory control, short closures, DO re-validations, port book reconciliation.
* Review management information system (MIS) reporting as applicable.
* Coordinate with vessel agents and charter of the vessel for smooth discharge of cargo and custom clearance
* Supervise and support team to achieve operational goal

**Key Stakeholders Internal:**

* Marketing
* Documentation /LC
* Finance and accounting
* Legal
* Logistics
* Customs

* Customers

**Educational Qualification**

* Bachelor’s degree in commerce, Engineering, Supply Chain, Logistics, Finance, or related discipline.
* MBA / PGDM (Finance, Operations, International Business) preferred.
* Additional certifications in Trade Finance, International Trade, Commercial Management, or Contract Management will be preferred.

**Experience**

* 8+ years of experience in Coal Trading, Commodities Trading, Mining, Energy, Metals, or Bulk Cargo industries.
* Proven experience in managing large-value domestic and international trading transactions.
* Extensive exposure to commercial operations, contract management, LC operations, trade finance, documentation, logistics, and regulatory compliance.
* Experience handling multiple stakeholders including customers, suppliers, banks, legal teams, shipping lines, customs authorities, and government agencies.

* Review available documentation and identify additional evidence required for successful petition preparation.

* Manage assigned L\-1A petitions from document collection through final filing.

* Monitor timelines and ensure milestones are achieved within scheduled deadlines.
* Coordinate all internal activities required for timely petition preparation.

* Collect corporate, financial, operational, employment, and legal documentation from clients.
* Regularly communicate with clients regarding pending documents and clarification requests.
* Verify the completeness, authenticity, and consistency of documents received.
* Maintain organized digital case files and document repositories.



  





**4\. Business Analysis \& Documentation:\-** 



* Develop a comprehensive understanding of the client's Indian business, including operations,



 products or services, management structure, revenue model, and future expansion plans.
 


* Draft company profiles, business summaries, organizational descriptions, managerial narratives,



 and operational documentation relating to the Indian entity.
 


* Review business records to ensure all supporting evidence accurately reflects the client's actual



 business operations.
 


* Ensure documentation aligns with USCIS requirements and overall petition strategy.



  





**5\. Coordination with Business Plan Team:\-** 



* Coordinate with the Business Plan Team to provide complete business information required for



 preparation of U.S. business plans.
 


* Share operational data, financial inputs, organizational information, hiring plans, investment



 details, and business objectives.
 


* Review draft business plans to ensure consistency with the petition narrative and supporting



 documentation.
 


* Coordinate revisions whenever inconsistencies or additional requirements are identified.



  





**6\. Drafting Immigration Documents:\-** 



* Prepare L\-1A immigration documentation, including support letters, organizational explanations,



 management narratives, job descriptions, company summaries, qualifying relationship documents,
 



 and other supporting materials.
 


* Draft explanatory letters and supporting documents required for petition preparation.
* Ensure all drafted documentation is internally consistent and factually accurate.



  





**7\. Internal Coordination:\-** 



* Coordinate with the Graphics Team for preparation of organizational charts, company structure



 diagrams, office layouts, marketing materials, presentation graphics, and other visual evidence
 



 supporting the petition.
 


* Work closely with document preparation, quality control, legal, and management teams



 throughout the case lifecycle.
 


* Facilitate timely resolution of documentation queries across departments.



  





**8\. Quality Control \& Documentation Review:\-** 



* Perform comprehensive quality checks of all petition documents before submission.
* Review drafted documents for accuracy, completeness, formatting consistency, grammar, and



 compliance with internal quality standards.
 


* Cross\-verify information across all supporting documents to eliminate discrepancies.
* Ensure financial records, corporate documents, organizational charts, employment records, and



 business plans remain consistent throughout the petition

* Prepare Form I\-129 and all applicable L classification supporting documentation.
* Verify that all mandatory forms, exhibits, supporting evidence, and filing documents are included



 prior to submission.
 


* Coordinate final review and filing of petitions with senior management.

* Maintain complete electronic and physical case records throughout the lifecycle of each petition.
* Ensure all confidential client information is handled in accordance with company policies.
* Update internal case management systems with accurate case progress and documentation



 status.
 


* Stay informed regarding USCIS policy updates, L\-1A regulations, filing requirements, and documentation standards.



  





**Required Skills:\-** 



* Strong understanding of U.S. L\-1A Business Immigration processes.
* Excellent business analysis and documentation skills.
* Strong drafting and technical writing ability.
* Excellent organizational and time management skills.
* High attention to detail with strong quality control capabilities.

 We are looking for a hands\-on Legal Manager to manage day\-to\-day legal, contractual and compliance matters supporting operations across the UAE, Saudi Arabia and India.
 



 The role requires a commercially practical lawyer who can independently manage contracts, legal research, documentation, compliance tracking, operational claims and coordination with external counsel.
 



  





 This is an individual\-contributor role with meaningful ownership. It is not a Head of Legal position, and jurisdiction\-specific UAE and Saudi legal opinions will be supported by qualified local counsel.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Commercial Contracts** 



* Draft, review and negotiate commercial agreements, NDAs, vendor agreements, technology agreements, service agreements, partnership agreements and other business contracts.
* Prepare and review agreements with operational partners, suppliers, corporate customers, dealerships, garages, insurers and other business partners.
* Review customer\-facing terms, subscription conditions, cancellation and refund policies, promotional terms and other consumer documentation.
* Identify contractual risks relating to liability, indemnity, insurance, data protection, intellectual property, termination, payment terms, service levels and dispute resolution.
* Maintain standard templates, fallback positions and practical negotiation playbooks for recurring agreements.



  





**Regulatory and Compliance Support** 



* Research and monitor laws and regulations relevant to business activities across the UAE, Saudi Arabia and India.
* Support management in assessing regulatory requirements relating to mobility, transport, consumer protection, employment, outsourcing, digital services and data protection.
* Coordinate with external legal counsel in the UAE, Saudi Arabia and India, prepare clear instructions and convert external advice into actionable recommendations.
* Maintain a country\-wise compliance calendar, licence tracker, legal risk register and regulatory documentation repository.
* Support legal reviews for new services, partnerships, product features, market launches and operational changes.
* Assist with responses to regulators, authorities and formal legal notices in coordination with external counsel.



  





**Operational Claims and Disputes** 



* Support the handling of customer complaints, accidents, vehicle\-damage claims, insurance matters, partner breaches, employee disputes and other operational incidents.
* Review the relevant contracts, evidence, insurance position and potential liability before recommending a course of action.
* Draft and respond to legal notices, settlement correspondence, breach notices and other dispute\-related communications.
* Coordinate with operations, insurance providers, external counsel and other stakeholders to resolve matters efficiently.
* Maintain proper records of disputes, claims, settlements and ongoing legal exposure.



  





**Corporate and Employment Matters** 



* Support corporate governance requirements, including resolutions, signing authorities, corporate records, intercompany agreements and statutory documentation.
* Assist with employment agreements, confidentiality obligations, intellectual\-property assignments, employee policies, disciplinary matters and terminations.
* Support HR with workplace investigations and sensitive employee matters where legal review is required.
* Coordinate statutory and corporate compliance for India operations with company secretarial, tax and external legal advisers.



  





**Data Protection, Technology and Intellectual Property** 



* Review privacy policies, data\-processing agreements, technology contracts and vendor data\-protection terms.
* Support compliance relating to customer, employee and partner data, including location information, call recordings, identity documents and cross\-border data access.
* Coordinate with technology and information\-security teams on data incidents, vendor risk and privacy requirements.
* Protect intellectual property through appropriate contractual provisions, employee and contractor assignments, confidentiality controls and trademark coordination.



  





**Fundraising and Strategic Matters** 



* Support legal due diligence, document collection, data\-room management and responses to investor legal queries.
* Assist external counsel and management with financing documents, investment transactions, corporate restructuring and other strategic matters.
* Track post\-transaction obligations, approvals, reporting requirements and contractual commitments.

* Own the contract repository and ensure executed agreements, amendments and supporting documents are properly maintained.
* Track contract renewals, notice periods, expiry dates, commercial commitments and compliance obligations.
* Develop practical legal templates, internal policies, approval workflows and documentation standards.
* Maintain visibility on pending contracts, claims, legal notices, regulatory matters and external\-counsel assignments.
* Use appropriate contract\-management and productivity tools to improve turnaround time and reduce manual work.

* Bachelor's degree in Law and enrolment with a recognised Bar Council in India.
* Approximately 5 to 8 years of post\-qualification legal experience.

* Working knowledge of Indian corporate, commercial, employment, consumer and data\-protection laws.

* Clear written and verbal communication skills, particularly the ability to explain legal issues to non\-legal stakeholders.

* Comfort working closely with teams based in the UAE, Saudi Arabia and India.

* Commercial contracts are completed accurately and within agreed timelines.
* Legal risks are identified early and communicated clearly.
* Agreements, renewals, claims and compliance obligations are properly tracked.
* External counsel is engaged efficiently and provided with clear, complete instructions.

 To support and manage day\-to\-day treasury operations, including repayment planning, borrowing and limit monitoring, asset allocation, DA payouts, NACH coordination, banking activities, treasury MIS, liquidity risk management, and regulatory/compliance requirements.

 1\.Repayment \& Borrowing Management
 


* Prepare and maintain repayment schedules covering principal, interest, and other applicable charges.
* Coordinate with banks and internal teams for timely processing of repayments.
* Ensure repayment data is accurately recorded and reconciled with books, bank statements, and internal MIS.
* Monitor upcoming repayment obligations and highlight funding requirements in advance.
* Support management in effective utilisation and monitoring of borrowing facilities.



  





 2\. DA Payout \& Transaction Management
 


* Coordinate DA payouts and ensure timely processing of transactions.
* Validate transaction calculations and supporting documentation before processing.
* Coordinate with relevant internal teams and banking partners for transaction closure.
* Resolve transaction\-related discrepancies and queries.
* Provide necessary support during internal and external audits.

 4\. Asset Allocation \& Reconciliation

* Ensure proper mapping of assets to borrowing/funding arrangements.
* Conduct periodic reconciliation of asset allocation.
* Identify and resolve mismatches, excess allocation, or double allocation.
* Maintain appropriate records and supporting documentation.

 7\. Limit Utilisation Monitoring

* Ensure timely reporting of utilisation levels to relevant stakeholders.
* Proactively highlight excess utilisation, low availability, or upcoming limit requirements.
* Support effective utilisation of available borrowing limits.

* Coordinate with relevant teams for data and supporting documents.
* Maintain proper records for audit and future reference.

* Provide required documents, reconciliations, schedules, and transaction details.
* Ensure timely closure of audit observations related to treasury operations.
* Follow established treasury processes, controls, and approval mechanisms.
